identificationModule.briefTitle: Safety, Tolerability, Pharmacokinetics (PK), and Primary Clinical Efficacy of LY01616 in Patients With Advanced Solid Tumors
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Multicenter Phase I/II Clinical Study to Evaluate the Safety and Primary Efficacy of LY01616 (Irinotecan Hydrochloride and Floxuridine Liposome Injection) in Patients With Advanced Solid Tumors

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a multicenter, open, dose escalation, single and multiple administration phase Ⅰ/Ⅱ clinical study to evaluate the safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics (PK), and primary clinical efficacy of LY01616 in patients with advanced solid tumors
